verdict.rationale: Hardware vendors can plausibly ship official command-line tools for their chips, so this axis applies to a processor. However, the evidence pack never documents an official CLI for the Core Ultra 7 258V. OpenVINO, oneAPI and VTune are described only as toolkits and developer stacks, with no command-line interface mentioned, so they cannot be credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
